title: Grimoire Archive: Integrations
summary: Connect Grimoire archives to Terminal, Index, Arcana Core, scans, and optional gameplay providers.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Terminal hosts Grimoire, Arcane Index supplies facts, Arcana Core supplies definitions, and optional providers supply live or generated archive rows.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Grimoire before forbidden actions, Index for exact layouts, Lens for field scans, and MissionCore for route progress.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If live bridge data is absent, static starter entries should still explain the system and name the missing source.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
